figs.name: photoelectric-sensor-types-through-beam-retro-diffuse-diagram
figs.alt: photoelectric sensor types diagram with through beam, retro reflective and diffuse reflective modes
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog comparing the three photoelectric sensor sensing modes: through beam with separate emitter and receiver, retro reflective with a reflector, and diffuse reflective from the object.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Three photoelectric sensor types: through beam, retro reflective and diffuse reflective</title>
<rect width="800" height="600" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3 Types of Photoelectric Sensor</text>
<rect x="20" y="80" width="760" height="160" rx="14" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="40" y="110" font-size="20" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">1. Through beam</text>
<text x="760" y="110" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">Object blocks the beam to the separate receiver</text>
<rect x="20" y="255" width="760" height="160" rx="14" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="40" y="285" font-size="20" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">2. Retro reflective</text>
<text x="760" y="285" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">Light returns from a reflector; object blocks it</text>
<rect x="20" y="430" width="760" height="160" rx="14" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="40" y="460" font-size="20" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">3. Diffuse reflective</text>
<text x="760" y="460" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">The object itself reflects light back</text>
<rect x="50" y="140" width="120" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="110" y="182" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Emitter</text>
<rect x="630" y="140" width="120" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="690" y="182" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Receiver</text>
<line x1="172" y1="175" x2="360" y2="175" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="4"/>
<line x1="440" y1="175" x2="628" y2="175" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="6 6"/>
<rect x="362" y="135" width="76" height="80" rx="6" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400" y="181" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Object</text>
<text x="530" y="160" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">no light</text>
<rect x="50" y="310" width="150" height="85" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="125" y="340" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Emitter and</text>
<text x="125" y="363" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">receiver</text>
<line x1="202" y1="330" x2="655" y2="330" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="655" y1="375" x2="202" y2="375" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="660,310 700,330 660,352 700,373 660,395" fill="#fde68a" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="745" y="405" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Reflector</text>
<text x="430" y="357" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">beam goes out and back</text>
<rect x="50" y="485" width="150" height="85" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="125" y="515" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Emitter and</text>
<text x="125" y="538" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">receiver</text>
<line x1="202" y1="505" x2="525" y2="505" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="525" y1="550" x2="202" y2="550" stroke="#dc2626" stroke-width="3" marker-end="url(#ah)" stroke-dasharray="7 5"/>
<rect x="530" y="485" width="90" height="85" rx="6" fill="#9ca3af" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="575" y="533" font-size="17" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Object</text>
<text x="365" y="532" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">reflected light</text>
</svg>

figs.name: photoelectric-sensor-working-sequence-flowchart
figs.alt: how a photoelectric sensor works from emitter light to receiver and output signal
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the photoelectric sensor working sequence: emitter light, object blocking or reflecting it, receiver, amplifier, detection circuit and digital or analog output.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 520" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>How a photoelectric sensor detects an object, from emitter light to output signal</title>
<rect width="800" height="520" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How a Photoelectric Sensor Detects an Object</text>
<rect x="40" y="80" width="210" height="110" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="145.0" y="117.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">1. Emitter</text>
<text x="145.0" y="141.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">LED or laser</text>
<text x="145.0" y="165.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">diode makes light</text>
<line x1="252" y1="135" x2="288" y2="135" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="290" y="80" width="210" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="395.0" y="117.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">2. Light path</text>
<text x="395.0" y="141.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">object blocks</text>
<text x="395.0" y="165.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">or reflects it</text>
<line x1="502" y1="135" x2="538" y2="135" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="540" y="80" width="210" height="110" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="645.0" y="117.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">3. Receiver</text>
<text x="645.0" y="141.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">photodiode or</text>
<text x="645.0" y="165.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">phototransistor</text>
<polyline points="645,192 645,240" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="540" y="245" width="210" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="645.0" y="282.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4. Amplifier</text>
<text x="645.0" y="305.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">light change to</text>
<text x="645.0" y="328.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">electrical signal</text>
<line x1="538" y1="300" x2="502" y2="300" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="290" y="245" width="210" height="110" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="395.0" y="282.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">5. Detection circuit</text>
<text x="395.0" y="305.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">checks the light came</text>
<text x="395.0" y="328.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">from its own emitter</text>
<line x1="288" y1="300" x2="252" y2="300" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="245" width="210" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="145.0" y="282.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">6. Output</text>
<text x="145.0" y="305.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">object detected</text>
<text x="145.0" y="328.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">signal sent</text>
<polyline points="145,357 145,395" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="40" y="400" width="330" height="90" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205.0" y="439.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Digital output</text>
<text x="205.0" y="462.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ON or OFF to PLC, relay, alarm</text>
<rect x="430" y="400" width="330" height="90" rx="10" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="595.0" y="439.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Analog output</text>
<text x="595.0" y="462.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">voltage or current to light level</text>
<polyline points="145,395 595,395 595,398" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
</svg>

figs.name: photoelectric-sensor-light-on-dark-on-output-infographic
figs.alt: photoelectric sensor light on and dark on output table with PNP and NPN outputs
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing when a photoelectric sensor output switches in Light On and Dark On modes for through beam, retro and diffuse types, plus PNP and NPN outputs.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Light On and Dark On output modes with sourcing PNP and sinking NPN outputs</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Photoelectric Sensor Output Modes</text>
<rect x="30" y="70" width="260" height="50" rx="0" fill="#d97706" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="160.0" y="102" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Condition</text>
<rect x="290" y="70" width="240" height="50" rx="0" fill="#d97706" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="410.0" y="102" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Light On</text>
<rect x="530" y="70" width="240" height="50" rx="0" fill="#d97706" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="650.0" y="102" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Dark On</text>
<rect x="30" y="120" width="260" height="70" rx="0" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="290" y="120" width="240" height="70" rx="0" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="530" y="120" width="240" height="70" rx="0" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="45" y="150" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Through beam or retro:</text>
<text x="45" y="174" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">beam reaches receiver</text>
<text x="410" y="162" font-size="18" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output ON</text>
<text x="650" y="162" font-size="18" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output OFF</text>
<rect x="30" y="190" width="260" height="70" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="290" y="190" width="240" height="70" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="530" y="190" width="240" height="70" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="45" y="220" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Through beam or retro:</text>
<text x="45" y="244" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">object breaks beam</text>
<text x="410" y="232" font-size="18" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output OFF</text>
<text x="650" y="232" font-size="18" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output ON</text>
<rect x="30" y="260" width="260" height="70" rx="0" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="290" y="260" width="240" height="70" rx="0" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="530" y="260" width="240" height="70" rx="0" fill="#fff7ed" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="45" y="290" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Diffuse:</text>
<text x="45" y="314" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">object reflects light</text>
<text x="410" y="302" font-size="18" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output ON</text>
<text x="650" y="302" font-size="18" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output OFF</text>
<rect x="30" y="330" width="260" height="70" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="290" y="330" width="240" height="70" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<rect x="530" y="330" width="240" height="70" rx="0" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#e5c9a0" stroke-width="1.5"/>
<text x="45" y="360" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Diffuse:</text>
<text x="45" y="384" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">no object, no light</text>
<text x="410" y="372" font-size="18" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output OFF</text>
<text x="650" y="372" font-size="18" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Output ON</text>
<rect x="30" y="420" width="360" height="115" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="210" y="455" font-size="20" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sourcing (PNP)</text>
<text x="210" y="485" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">gives positive voltage</text>
<text x="210" y="510" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">to the load when ON</text>
<rect x="410" y="420" width="360" height="115" rx="12" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="590" y="455" font-size="20" fill="#92400e" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Sinking (NPN)</text>
<text x="590" y="485" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">connects the load to</text>
<text x="590" y="510" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">ground or negative</text>
</svg>
